steps.instructions: Phase 1/2 SCOPE: map the personal data in scope: what is collected, where it is stored, who and what can read it, where it is sent, how long it is kept and how it is deleted. GROUND FIRST: query the code graph through the wicked-garden-search skill and the read-only estate shim, one call per lookup: "$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/_estate_client.py --readonly call '{"tool":"SearchEntity","arguments":{"name":"<symbol>"}}' (always --readonly); then open and read every file you cite, at the lines you cite. READ-ONLY: create, edit or delete no file in any repository, commit nothing, and run no command that writes there; your output is the report.

Phase 2/2 PRIVACY REVIEW (privacy expert): report each place personal data is handled beyond what its purpose needs, or without its consent, retention or deletion, with its file:line, its severity and the change it needs, the most severe first. Change nothing yourself: a fix is a separate job. PASS only when every finding holds at file:line.
